title: Device Diamond: virtual inheritance & construction order
hints: The starter's `class Powered : public Device` gives SmartLidar TWO Device subobjects. Inherit `virtual public Device` in BOTH Powered and Networked.

With a virtual base, the MOST-DERIVED class constructs it: SmartLidar's initializer list must call `Device(id)`. The `Device(id)` calls in Powered/Networked are skipped when they're bases of SmartLidar (but still used when you construct a standalone Powered).
Construction order: virtual bases first, then non-virtual direct bases in declaration order (Powered, Networked), then members, then the body. Destruction is the exact reverse.
deviceId()/totalBoots() can just call id()/bootCount(). With one shared Device they're no longer ambiguous.
